title: panicum compositum
intro: Panicum compositum, commonly known as Panic grass, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Panicum compositum include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular choice in traditional herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
